review_candidates.title: Human Resources Business Partner
review_candidates.description: Are you a people-oriented HR professional with a strategic mindset and a passion for building strong teams and fostering a positive workplace culture? Movement on the Ground is seeking a motivated and results-driven HR Business Partner to support our HR strategy, strengthen HR processes and contribute to a positive employee experience across Greece. This is a unique opportunity to play an active role in shaping and implementing HR practices, while helping to build a better world by building better communities.   Our Vision We envision a world where every individual, regardless of background, feels a sense of belonging and is enabled to reach their full potential. Movement On The Ground is an international NGO focused on creating dignified refugee reception centres. Through our ‘Camp to CampUs’ approach forcibly displaced people can return to being active members of society. Over the last ten years we have impacted over 250,000 people with community-led projects across 3 continents, including Europe, the MENA region, and Africa. MOTG operates in Greece, supporting displaced communities through different programmes focused on education, integration, protection and employability. As our organisation continues to grow, we are strengthening our HR capacity to ensure that our teams receive the support they need throughout their employee journey.   About the role At Movement On The Ground, we believe that building better communities starts with people. The people who show up, take initiative, challenge the status quo and bring our mission to life every day. As our HR Business Partner in Greece, you will play an important role in creating an environment where our people and teams can thrive. You will work closely with employees, team leaders and the wider HR team, making sure that our HR support and processes reflect our values and put people at the centre. Together with another HR Business Partner, you will support our teams across Greece, bringing a hands-on approach to HR while helping us continuously improve the way we work. From welcoming new colleagues to supporting team leaders, navigating people challenges and finding better ways of working, you will be a trusted partner throughout the employee journey.   You will… Make HR Work for People ·       Be a trusted point of contact for employees and team leaders, offering practical guidance and support on day-to-day HR matters. ·       Coordinate recruitment processes, from identifying team needs to finding and welcoming new colleagues. ·       Make sure onboarding and offboarding are more than just processes, creating a smooth and positive experience for everyone involved. ·       Keep our HR administration running smoothly, including employment contracts, leave management, employee records and payroll-related processes. ·       Ensure that our people practices comply with Greek labour legislation and MOTG policies and procedures. Build Strong Teams & Positive Experiences ·       Partner with team leaders to understand their challenges, anticipate people-related needs and find practical solutions. ·       Contribute to a working environment where people feel supported, connected and able to do their best work. ·       Support initiatives around employee engagement, wellbeing and team connection. ·       Build meaningful relationships across our teams and maintain an active HR presence throughout Greece, including occasional visits to our project locations. Make Things Better, Together ·       Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of HR processes and initiatives across MOTG. ·       Identify opportunities to make the way we work more effective, consistent and people-centred. ·       Work closely with the wider HR team, sharing knowledge, exchanging ideas and helping shape our evolving people practices.   What you bring… ·       At least 3 years of experience in HR, preferably in an HR Business Partner, HR Advisor or HR Generalist role. ·       Experience coordinating recruitment, onboarding, offboarding and employee administration. ·       A good understanding of Greek labour legislation and HR administration. ·       A genuine interest in people and the ability to build trusting relationships across different teams and backgrounds. ·       A hands-on and solutions-oriented mindset. You don't wait for things to happen; you take initiative and make things happen. ·       Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities independently. ·       Confidence in communicating with different stakeholders and navigating people-related challenges. ·       The ability to thrive in a dynamic, multicultural environment where flexibility, collaboration and taking initiative matter. ·       Professional proficiency in Greek and English. Knowledge of Arabic is considered a strong asset. ·       Willingness to travel occasionally to support our teams across different locations in Greece.   Ready to join us? Are you someone who believes that strong teams make meaningful impact? Do you enjoy working with people, finding solutions and making things happen? Join us in building a workplace where people feel supported, connected and motivated to bring their best to our shared mission. Send your CV and motivation letter to people@movementontheground.com, with the subject line: Application – HR Business Partner (Greece).   Movement on the Ground is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected characteristic.

Our Human Resources team plays a critical role in supporting our workforce and ensuring that employees receive the resources, guidance, and support needed to succeed. We are currently seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Human Resources Assistant to join our team and contribute to the smooth operation of our HR department. The Human Resources Assistant will provide comprehensive administrative and operational support across various HR functions, including recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, record management, compliance, and internal communications. This role is ideal for an individual who enjoys working with people, has strong organizational skills, and is passionate about supporting employee success while maintaining accurate and confidential HR records. As a key member of the HR team, you will assist with day-to-day human resources activities and help ensure that HR processes are carried out efficiently and in accordance with company policies and employment regulations. Key Responsibilities: Recruitment & Hiring Support Assist with the recruitment process by posting job advertisements, screening applications, and coordinating interviews. Schedule interviews and communicate with candidates throughout the hiring process. Prepare offer letters, employment contracts, and onboarding documentation. Maintain recruitment records and applicant tracking systems. Employee Onboarding & Administration Coordinate new employee onboarding and orientation activities. Prepare employee files and ensure all required documentation is completed and maintained. Assist employees with HR-related inquiries and requests. Maintain accurate employee records, databases, and filing systems. HR Operations & Compliance Ensure employee records remain current, accurate, and compliant with company policies and legal requirements. Assist in monitoring HR procedures and compliance standards. Support the preparation of HR reports, metrics, and documentation. Help administer employee policies, handbooks, and workplace procedures. Employee Engagement & Support Support employee engagement initiatives, training programs, and company events. Assist with performance review administration and employee development activities. Coordinate internal communications related to HR programs and announcements. Foster positive relationships with employees across all departments. General Administrative Duties Manage HR correspondence, calendars, and meeting schedules. Prepare reports, presentations, and HR-related documents. Organize and maintain confidential personnel records. Provide administrative support to the HR Manager and wider leadership team as required. Qualifications: High school diploma, Associate's or Bachelor's degree. Strong organizational and multitasking abilities. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint. Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with discretion. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Professional, approachable, and team-oriented attitude. What We Offer: Competitive salary package. Professional development and career advancement opportunities. Supportive and collaborative work environment. Employee training and development programs. Comprehensive onboarding and ongoing support. Opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to employee success and organizational growth. If you are passionate about human resources, enjoy supporting people, and thrive in a fast-paced professional environment, we invite you to apply and become an important part of our HR team.

review_candidates.description: Pour notre organisation, et plus particulièrement notre service Administration & Logistique, nous recherchons un(e) assistant(e) comptable et administratif(ve) (temps plein). L'Association Muco L'Association Muco est l'association nationale des enfants, adolescents et adultes atteints de mucoviscidose et de leurs familles. La mucoviscidose est la maladie héréditaire la plus fréquente et la plus grave en Belgique. Chaque jour, nous œuvrons pour améliorer la qualité de vie des personnes atteintes de mucoviscidose dans notre pays. Vos missions : En tant qu'assistant(e) comptable et administratif(ve), vous gérez les opérations financières quotidiennes et apportez un soutien administratif essentiel. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec notre expert-comptable et l'équipe de direction afin de garantir la transparence, l'exactitude des opérations et la conformité à la législation. Comptabilité et gestion financière : ·      Traitement des transactions financières quotidiennes et des factures fournisseurs et clients. ·      Vérification, codification et saisie des factures et des notes de frais dans le logiciel. ·      Rapprochements bancaires et suivi de la trésorerie. • Participation à l'élaboration des états financiers mensuels, trimestriels et annuels. ·      Gérer et assurer le suivi des certificats fiscaux des donateurs et des subventions. ·      Être le principal interlocuteur de notre expert-comptable et de notre commissaire aux comptes. Soutien administratif : ·      Tenir à jour les systèmes de classement physique et numérique des documents financiers. ·      Apporter un soutien administratif aux ressources humaines, notamment pour la gestion des congés, des absences et des données de paie. ·      Traiter le courrier entrant, les courriels et les demandes administratives. ·      Gérer les fournitures de bureau, les contrats de maintenance et la logistique générale. ·      Apporter un soutien administratif pour les événements et campagnes de collecte de fonds. Votre profil et vos compétences ·       Formation : Licence en comptabilité, gestion d'entreprise ou expérience équivalente. ·       Expérience : Au moins 2 à 3 ans d'expérience en comptabilité et administration. Une expérience dans le secteur associatif belge (association d'organismes sans but lucratif) est un atout majeur. • Langues : Maîtrise du néerlandais et du français (à l'écrit comme à l'oral) indispensable. La connaissance de l'anglais est un plus. ·       Compétences techniques : Maîtrise de la suite MS Office (notamment Excel) et expérience des logiciels comptables et des ERP appréciées. ·       Qualités : Rigueur, organisation, autonomie et discrétion concernant les informations confidentielles. Excellentes compétences informatiques et connaissance actualisée des techniques de communication numérique. ·      Capacité à gérer simultanément et avec précision diverses tâches et projets, tout en conservant une vision d'ensemble et une cohérence. ·      Esprit d'équipe et aptitude à collaborer efficacement avec les autres services. Nous offrons : ·      Un poste à temps plein dans nos bureaux d'Oudergem (près de la gare Delta), en CDI. ·      Une rémunération attractive. L'ancienneté sera prise en compte. ·      Une semaine de travail de 38 heures. ·      Avantages sociaux : 13e mois de salaire complet, assurance collective sans participation financière, titres-restaurant, indemnité kilométrique, assurance hospitalisation. • Horaires flexibles et possibilité de télétravail régulier. ·      Une équipe dynamique de collègues et de bénévoles. ·      Possibilités de développement et de formation. Pour toute question concernant ce poste, veuillez nous envoyer un courriel ; nous vous contacterons par téléphone.

review_candidates.title: Civil Engineer
review_candidates.description: Kesempatan PT. Cahaya Kota Nusantara membuka kesempatan bagi engineer muda untuk bergabung sebagai Junior Civil Engineer (Structural) di Bintan, Kepulauan Riau . Posisi ini ditujukan bagi kandidat yang ingin mengembangkan karier di bidang teknik sipil dan struktural melalui pengalaman langsung dalam perancangan, analisis, dan pengawasan struktur bangunan pada proyek konstruksi. Sebagai bagian dari tim engineering, Anda akan bekerja bersama engineer berpengalaman, mengembangkan kemampuan teknis, serta berkontribusi dalam pelaksanaan proyek konstruksi di kawasan Bintan. Posisi ini merupakan full-time position dengan kesempatan untuk berkembang secara profesional di industri teknik dan konstruksi.   Kualifikasi Memiliki pengalaman lebih dari 1-2 tahun di bidang Civil & Structural Engineering meliputi perencanaan, analisis struktur, estimasi biaya, dan pengawasan proyek. Berpengalaman menangani proyek gedung, gudang, jembatan, kawasan industri, serta modular building (E-House). Menguasai software engineering seperti SAP2000, ETABS, Robot Structural Analysis, MIDAS Civil, Geo5, Idea Statica, dan AutoCAD. Memiliki kemampuan dalam analisis struktur beton, baja, dan geoteknik. Berpengalaman dalam penyusunan RAB, quantity take-off, cost estimation, dan tender project. Memiliki kemampuan problem solving yang baik dalam penyelesaian kendala desain maupun konstruksi di lapangan. Mampu berkoordinasi dengan tim engineering, produksi, dan pihak terkait untuk memastikan kelancaran proyek. Memiliki orientasi kerja pada kualitas hasil, efisiensi desain, dan optimalisasi biaya proyek. Bersedia ditempatkan di lokasi proyek/luar kota serta bekerja sesuai kebutuhan operasional perusahaan. Memiliki komunikasi yang baik, sikap profesional, dan motivasi tinggi untuk pengembangan karier di bidang engineering. Tentang Kami PT. Cahaya Kota Nusantara merupakan perusahaan yang bergerak dalam pengembangan infrastruktur dan proyek konstruksi di Indonesia, khususnya di kawasan Kepulauan Riau. Kami berkomitmen menghadirkan proyek berkualitas dengan mengutamakan profesionalisme, integritas, keselamatan kerja, dan standar kualitas yang tinggi. Kami percaya bahwa keberhasilan setiap proyek dibangun melalui tim yang kompeten, kolaborasi yang kuat, serta inovasi yang berkelanjutan. Karena itu, kami terus membangun lingkungan kerja yang mendukung pengembangan kompetensi dan pertumbuhan profesional setiap individu. Bergabunglah bersama kami dan menjadi bagian dari tim yang berkontribusi dalam membangun serta mengembangkan infrastruktur Indonesia.
